comments.content: This constructs the DirectML causal mask from uninitialized memory. `triu_(1)` only zeros entries below the diagonal, leaving arbitrary values above it, so future tokens may be unmasked or receive random attention biases. Initialize the tensor with a supported large negative value before applying `triu_(1)` (as the previous implementation did), or build a triangular boolean mask and `masked_fill` its upper triangle.
